evidence.reason: verify_archive now copies the archive into a private 0700 TemporaryDirectory before hashing and passes that private copy to _safe_extract, so the digest reported and every extraction/manifest/inventory/smoke read observe the same bytes even if the original pathname is replaced afterwards; tests were not run because the harness only permits git inspection/commit commands.
